PROPER - a proper synth for house music (Linux)
https://github.com/VouDoo/proper-synth

What's in here
  Proper        the standalone app
  Proper.clap   the CLAP plugin
  Proper.vst3   the VST3 plugin

Standalone app
  Find your MIDI keyboard's name (an empty name lists them all):
    ./Proper -b alsa --midi-input ""
  Then play:
    ./Proper -b alsa --midi-input "<your keyboard>" --tempo 125
  Run ./Proper --help for every option.

Plugins
  Copy them into your plugin folders, then rescan in your DAW:
    mkdir -p ~/.clap ~/.vst3
    cp -r Proper.clap ~/.clap/
    cp -r Proper.vst3 ~/.vst3/

  the address above.
